title: Swap two values
promptHtml: Write swap_ints so that it exchanges the values of its two arguments. The caller must see the change, so the parameters cannot be plain copies.
hints:
A parameter declared int a is a copy. Changing it changes nothing outside the function.

int& a makes the parameter another name for the caller’s variable.

You need somewhere to put the first value while you overwrite it.
solutionNotesHtml: The last check matters more than it looks. When both references name the same object, a careless implementation can zero it out. This one survives: temp holds the value before anything is overwritten. The standard library’s std::swap does the same thing generically, using a move instead of a copy.
